Former Pyre

In boss fights an otherworldly bonfire appears, burning higher from your hostile actions, naturally regulating the pace of the fight.

Acid and radiant damage douse it.

Enable?

Battle Instinct

On its first turn of combat a powerful creature resists all damage, rolls better on saving throws and cannot be critically hit.

Enable?

Item Move Cost

Moving an item during combat costs a Bonus Action, then an Action, then ends the turn.

Enable?

Anti-Theft

Traders react properly to being robbed instead of ignoring it.

Enable?

Anti-Stealth-Abuse

Enemy AI no longer switches off while you hide inside Darkness and fog clouds, and no longer walks away after a while, robbing you of the experience and the loot.

Enable?

Avarice

Void Capsules after fights, larger trader stock and planar coins.

It sits close to cheating: with it the party ends Act 2 dressed in legendaries.

Enable?

Trials of Tav shop

A shop built for another mod rather than for the campaign.

It affects balance heavily.

Enable?
